title: Moons retexture
description: My re-texturing of certain items! will be updated eventually
body:
This is my take on a re textureing of some of the items. i have seen this done before but i wanted to try it in my style of pixelart. although some of them might not be the best, i still tried to make them look as good as possible.![A wall with the diffrent items on display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca38650f48e1419d78492414ef669ab6d7242084.png)
